column1: # docs/doc_locks.tsv — the load-bearing numbers the docs share, locked across
# A row means: every listed file quotes `canonical` verbatim, and on any line
# where `key` appears, no other value of the same shape sits within 80 chars
# after it unless it is in `also`. Add a row when a number is quoted in a
# second document; the canonical file is the atlas row (docs/game/atlas/) —
# a synthesis or a plan follows the atlas, never the other way round.
# SINCE 14z-122 a key matching ZERO lines across its files FAILS ("matches
# NOTHING") — a reflow that rewords the fact's label used to disarm the
# NO-RIVAL half silently while PRESENCE stayed green. Keys were re-verified
# live against the tree at 14z-122; a purely canonical-quoting key cannot
# catch a rival, but liveness now makes its decay loud, which was the defect.
# (cursor_highlight_base `also`: 0x268A82 is the P2 mirror; 0x2A18FE is vsav2's own table, select_screen.md "vs2 carries the same three arrays")
# --- 14z-122, the documentation rationalization pass: the duplicated numbers
# --- the pass collapses to one canonical home stay LOCKED in every carrier.
# (mra_profile_byte: cps2_wide.md describes byte 41 without quoting 0xFE, so it
#  is not a PRESENCE carrier; the canonical home is platform/mister.md "The
# (wide_rom_bytes `also`: the four header words of that same .rom, which
#  legitimately sit beside the size in mister_map.md §3, and the 3,500-frame
#  run length that sits beside the name at platform/mister.md:1665. Separated
#  by ';' because a comma-grouped number cannot ride comma-splitting.)
